name: Chess
description: Chess word search puzzles gather board and piece English for adults and seniors — pawn, castle, endgame, gambit, knight and quiet strategy words — without chess-brand names or titled-event slogans. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays practical and unhurried: bishop, rook, clock, draw, fork and develop vocabulary many lifelong players already know. This hub pairs well with Board Games and Reading when you want a longer thinking afternoon. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as steady as a quiet opening.
